rationale: Select the registered static family because this condition supplies only final selected teacher clouds and removes trajectory and history information. The permitted native_rms_ratio and time_ramp_power settings are controlled hypotheses, not evidence-based optima; static uses beta=0, so time ramping contributes no temporal signal. No score or trajectory dependency is introduced.
failure_modes: No generated-state target pIC50 or strain results are supplied, so these settings cannot be claimed to improve either outcome.
The static family has no temporal signal; changing time_ramp_power may be operationally inert.
The original geometric evidence does not establish an optimal native_rms_ratio or validate a physical affinity landscape.
